comment: Per-model capability manifest for the direct gemini-veo adapter. Every value is READ OUT OF THE TREE and cited in input_notes. Only veo-3.0-generate-001 is an entry: it is the adapter default (adapters/gemini-veo.sh:129) and the XML <default-model> (agents/templates/.ai-video.xml.example:72). veo-3.0-fast* and veo-2.0* appear only as rate PREFIX PATTERNS (adapters/gemini-veo.sh:93-95) with no concrete model id in the tree, so no entries are invented for them. verified stays false: the adapter header records 10/10 live renders of this exact model (adapters/gemini-veo.sh:9-15) but names no trace id reachable from the tree, and the local traces are gitignored.

veo-3.0-generate-001.label: Google Veo 3 (text-to-video, native audio)
veo-3.0-generate-001.input_notes: model id from adapters/gemini-veo.sh:129 and agents/templates/.ai-video.xml.example:72; durationSeconds enum {4,6,8} is ASSUMED in the adapter header (:34-37) and is the clamp the adapter applies (:132-137), upper bound matching the template tuning <max-duration>8</max-duration> (xml:77); audio_sync true from the declared audio=native (:4), the dispatch flag (tail) and <audio-native>true</audio-native> (xml:78); aspect is passed through as aspectRatio with no enum check (:151) so the accepted set is unknown — the template's tuning default is 16:9 (xml:75); cost_per_second_usd from _veo_model_rate_usd_per_s veo-3.0* = 0.40 (:94), corroborated by the header's ~$1.60 per 4 s render at $0.40/s (:10)
